caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent drinking glass positioned upright and centrally on a plain, beige background. The glass is rendered in shades of green and light blue and features a textured diamond or honeycomb pattern on its surface. The base of the glass is thicker and slightly darker in color, and the rim is outlined with a thin, dark green line. Soft, diffuse shadows in shades of gray and green are cast to the left and below the glass, suggesting a light source coming from the right. In the lower left corner of the image, the signature "G. Capelli" appears in small, neat handwriting. The composition is uncluttered and focused solely on the glass, with ample empty space surrounding the object.
title: Tumbler
